title: primula calliantha subsp. kiuchiangensis
intro: Primula calliantha subsp. kiuchiangensis, commonly known as Kiuchiang primrose, is a species of flowering plant in the family Primulaceae. It is a perennial plant native to Taiwan, known for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The health benefits of Primula calliantha subsp. kiuchiangensis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its sedative and anti-anxiety effects, and its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
